customer_name: Los Angeles County Department of Human Resources
business_problem: However, managing a hiring process on this scale with legacy siloed data systems limited the department’s visibility into its pool of candidates and created bottlenecks within the hiring process. As a result, they discovered, it took an average of 384 days to hire a candidate, but they had no idea why or how to fix it.
solution_summary: Los Angeles County is one of the largest employers in the nation, and the mission of its Department of Human Resources (DHR) is to serve as the talent backbone that supports an ever-growing range of public services for over 10 million residents. However, managing a hiring process on this scale with legacy siloed data systems limited the department’s visibility into its pool of candidates and created bottlenecks within the hiring process. As a result, they discovered, it took an average of 384 days to hire a candidate, but they had no idea why or how to fix it. With Databricks Data + AI Platform on the Azure Cloud, DHR was able to democratize all of their candidates and hiring data countywide — providing them with the insights to streamline their hiring practices while lowering operational costs. With the right data at their fingertips, they can now be more competitive in hiring and retaining a diverse workforce passionate about public service.

solution_components.name: Azure Databricks
solution_components.role: Provides the Azure-based lakehouse workspace for ingesting, transforming, and serving governed data.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores curated lakehouse tables used for reliable downstream analytics and AI workloads.

data_flow: Operational, customer, and transactional data lands in Azure Databricks, is transformed in Delta Lake tables.
